To continue, someone needs to free space on the machine and re-allow shell commands. Then this step can be re-run from where it stopped.

## Changes made (edge functions, not checked or tested)

1. **`supabase/functions/_shared/paid-change-failure.ts`** (rewritten) — item 3, plus a money bug I found.
   - **Before:** if a paid swap couldn't be saved on a live booking, the refund went through `process-refund`. That overwrote the booking's stored payment id with the swap payment, marked the booking "refunded", and issued a credit note for a payment that never had a tax document. A later cancellation would then refund nothing from the original payment, and the final invoice would be 15 Kč off.
   - **After:** the swap payment is always refunded directly from its own Stripe payment, in full, exactly once. A first-entry-wins lock in `debug_log` and a fixed Stripe idempotency key prevent a second refund. The booking row is not touched and no credit note is issued.
   - A web Checkout session id is resolved to its payment before refunding.
   - Staff get a clearer internal e-mail. When the bike was taken, the subject says the bike was occupied meanwhile, the new booking has priority, and the surcharge was refunded. The e-mail now carries the booking id, so it shows up in Velín under Dokumenty → Zaslané maily.
   - New exports: `TAKEN_REASONS` and `failureReasonCs()`.

2. **`supabase/functions/process-payment/complete-extension.ts`** (rewritten) — item 3 on the web.
   - **Before:** only accepted a `payment_intent_id`, which the app sends.
   - **After:** also accepts the web's Checkout `session_id`. Change details are read from the session, and a 72-hour window applies instead of the app-only payment markers. When the bike was taken, the failure response now carries the text "Motorka je mezitím obsazená…". The handler can also take a test stand-in for Stripe and login checks.

3. **`supabase/functions/process-payment/refusals.ts`**: added that "bike taken" text as `change_failed_taken`.

4. **`supabase/functions/process-refund/other-intents.ts`** (new) and **`process-refund/index.ts`** (wired in) — item 1.
   - **Before:** a refund was capped at what was left on the booking's original payment. So a 100 % cancellation after a paid edit (including a rounded 15 Kč surcharge) never returned the surcharge or its rounding.
   - **After:** when a staff or server refund asks for more than the original payment covers, the rest is refunded from the booking's other successful payments, oldest first. It never touches e-shop payments, duplicate payments or payments for changes that failed. One credit note covers the total. The booking is marked partial if money remains, and staff get an e-mail if any amount is still left over. Refunds started by customers in the app are unchanged.

## Item 1 check
Cancellation already refunds the rounding proportionally: `cancel_booking_tracked` computes the refund as the percentage of the full price, and the price includes the rounding. The only gap was the payment-split case fixed in point 4.

I checked messages and web adversarially. The app and web parts of this step were never built (the previous run stopped on a full disk), so the owner's answers 2 and 3 are not met. The server side is mostly correct.

What holds:
- **Stripe amounts add up to exactly 15 Kč on the web.** Web booking (including a bundled shop order), web e-shop (items + shipping − coupon) and web edit all produce a separate rounding line, and the sum is 15 Kč. Amounts up to 1 Kč are waived. All of this only once SQL p1 is deployed.
- **App rounding display is in place in both trees.** It shows on the payment screen, shop checkout, edit price box and swap line. All `pd*` keys exist in all 8 languages, placeholders match, and no payment text contains contact details.
- **App trees match.** `diff -rq` of both `lib/` folders differs only in whitelisted files, v2 seams and v2-only files; payment files are identical.
- **Checks that ran:** `deno check` gives the same error sets as the baseline (process-payment 98, webhook-receiver 77, process-refund 0, paid-change-failure 0, other-intents 0). `php -l` passes on all `lang/*.php` and the changed pages. `node --check` passes on the swap, gear, checkout and scan scripts.

What fails:
- **Web never shows the rounding before payment.** None of the booking step, e-shop summary or edit/swap/gear confirm dialogs shows it. The customer sees, for example, "+10 Kč" on the web and 15 Kč on Stripe.
- **Stripe rounding line is Czech-only.** It reads in Czech for all 8 site languages.
- **Web swap conflict ends in a dead end.** When the bike was taken, the web shows either "Kontaktujte nás prosím" or a false "dokončujeme" message. It never says "Motorka je mezitím obsazená" and offers no next step. The return URL does not carry the session id, so the web cannot ask the server what happened.
- **App swap conflict lacks the requested title and buttons.** The title is still "Výměnu se nepodařilo dokončit" and there is no "Vybrat jinou motorku" / "Ponechat současnou motorku".
- **App refund text promises an e-mail that is not sent.** `pdRefundAuto` says a confirmation comes by e-mail. The new direct Stripe refund e-mails only info@.
- **One Deno test fails** (86 passed, 1 failed): `extension_apply_test.ts:211`, expected "auto", got "staff".
- **`flutter analyze` and app tests could not run.** There is no Flutter SDK on the machine and only about 357 MB of free disk.

That text has a contact, no refund info and no next step, while the webhook silently refunds. With rounding (1–15 Kč), _waitServerChange times out after 40 s and shows editRez.postStripe.finishing ('dokončujeme – za pár minut ji uvidíte'), which is false: the change will never be written and the money is refunded. The success_url ('/upravit-rezervaci?paid_booking=<id>', lines 358 and gear.js 228) has no session id, so the web cannot ask the server for the result (complete-extension.ts already accepts session_id).
issues.fix: 1) In swap.js, gear.js and the core extend/edit hooks, use success_url = origin + '/upravit-rezervaci?paid_booking=' + id + '&session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}'. Ignore a literal '{CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}' on the waive redirect. 2) After return, POST process-payment {action:'complete_extension', session_id} with the user's Bearer token and map the state. applied/already_applied → existing success and pickup. pending or HTTP 503 retry → finishing card and keep polling. failed with reason new_moto_unavailable|moto_unavailable → a new card titled 'Motorka je mezitím obsazená' with the body 'Během vaší platby si ji zarezervoval někdo jiný a nová rezervace má přednost. Vaše původní rezervace platí beze změny a doplatek {amount} vám automaticky vracíme na kartu (obvykle do 5–10 pracovních dnů).' plus buttons 'Vybrat jinou motorku' (ER._resumeEdit(id,'swap')) and 'Ponechat současnou motorku' (close → list). Other failed → a failed card with the refund line. not_paid → 'platba nebyla dokončena'. Never render the server's `error` (Czech, informal 'ty'). Keep the client commit only as a fallback when complete_extension returns 404/not deployed. 3) Add the new keys to all 8 lang/*.php files and to the $keys list in pages/upravit-rezervaci.php.

result.summary:
I checked the current branch state (HEAD 2ed11d5d). Note that the implementation report is out of date: the web part (card-rounding.js, paid.js, the swap/gear/core hooks, the lang keys in 8 languages, checkout/rezervace/upravit-rezervaci.php) and the app part ("Motorka je mezitím obsazená" with "Vybrat jinou / Ponechat současnou", ext_43 in 8 languages, both trees) were added in later WIP commits 08a4890c, 9c59e50e, 1a9baf10 and 2ed11d5d.

**Checks run:**
- **PHP and JS syntax:** `php -l` passes on all 8 lang files and the 4 changed pages. `node --check` passes on all changed JS.
- **Web node tests:** both scratchpad suites pass, `paydec/fix4/web/test_web.js` (44 tests) and `paydec/fix5/web/test_guard_paid.js` (25 tests).
- **Edge:**
  - Deno tests: 97 passed, 0 failed.
  - `deno check` error counts match the baseline: process-payment 98, webhook-receiver 77, generate-invoice 0, process-refund 0, paid-change-failure 0.
- **Flutter analyze:** 0 errors on Android (147 info/warnings, none new in payment files). 0 errors on iOS, run in a scratch copy at `scratchpad/vmsg/ios` (143 issues).
- **App tests:**
  - Android: 144 passed (all payment, queue and navigation tests).
  - iOS: the 9 payment test files, run against the iOS `lib`, gave 88 passed.
- **Tree parity:**
  - ext_43_payments is identical in both trees and complete in all 8 languages, with matching placeholders.
  - `paid_change_outcomes`, `payment_result_screen`, `payment_provider` and `paid_change_banner` are identical in both trees.
  - Every other differing file is either on the whitelist or an allowed v2 change (I checked `reservation_edit_screen`, `res_payment_details_tab`, `home_screen` and others).
- **Web texts:** all 30 new or changed payment keys exist in all 8 languages, with the same placeholders and no contact details.
- **Rendering:** a Playwright render of the booking step 2 at 390 px and 1280 px shows the rounding line directly under the total, and the amount next to the pay button changes to 15 Kč.

**Stripe Checkout line items are correct in all three web cases:** booking (+ bundled shop), e-shop (incl. coupon) and web edits all add up to exactly 1500 haléřů, with a translated rounding line.

**Requirements that hold:**
- The swap-conflict message is clear on web and in the app, with next steps and no contact details.
- Rounding is refunded pro rata on cancellation (folded into `total_price`).

**Problems found:**
- **Two major defects:**
  - The e-shop retry creates a new order and takes the items out of stock again on every click.
  - After an app restart, a swap that failed because the bike was taken shows a false "výměnu dokončujeme" (we are finishing your swap) notice.
- **Several minor message and display issues** (listed below).

issues.problem: The refusal handling was changed: the cart is kept, the button re-enabled and the texts say "zkuste to znovu". Before, the page redirected to the order confirmation with the existing order id. Now every click on Pay runs `create_web_shop_order` again. That RPC creates a new pending `shop_orders` row and always decrements `products.stock_quantity` / `size_stock`, and nothing restores the stock. So each retry after below_minimum, rounding_unavailable, stripe_unavailable or a network error leaves another pending order and takes the items out of stock again. On the last item in stock, the customer's own second try fails with out_of_stock. The node test 'e-shop below_minimum → košík zůstává … tlačítko znovu' covers only the text and the button, not this.
issues.fix: Keep the created order across clicks, like the reservation flow already does with `MG._rez._shopOrderId`. Store `{id:q, sig:JSON.stringify([items(h), shipping(i), address(d), name, email, phone, notes])}` in a closure variable outside the click handler. On click, skip `create_web_shop_order` when the cached sig matches and reuse the cached order id for `process-payment`, which already cancels or settles the previous session of that order through `settleStoredSession`. Clear the cache on a successful redirect. Extend `fix4/web/test_web.js`: two clicks after `below_minimum` must call `create_web_shop_order` exactly once.

issues.problem: `paidAfterRestartProvider` only collects queue events with status done. Typical case: the app is killed during 3D Secure or before `_onPaymentSuccess`, and the payment marker remains. On restart the queue completes the swap and the server answers failed / new_moto_unavailable, refunding the surcharge. The marker is not cleared. The marker loop then calls `verifyPayment(intentOnly: true)`, and the PaymentIntent is still 'succeeded' after a refund. So the app shows the snackbar `fxSwapPaidNotice` "Doplatek za výměnu motorky proběhl. Výměnu dokončujeme automaticky…". That is false. The correct "Motorka je mezitím obsazená" only appears if the customer opens the reservation detail (`PaidChangeBanner`). This is exactly the owner's "no signal / finishes later" scenario.
issues.fix: In the drain listener also collect `ev.result.status == PaidChangeStatus.failed`. For failed entries, clear their booking marker and return a failure notice instead of the success one: a new `PaidAfterRestart` flag, a snackbar titled `pdTakenTitle` (when `isTakenReason`) or `pdSwapFailedTitle`/`pdEditFailedTitle`, and an action that opens `/reservations/<id>`, where the banner offers Vybrat jinou / Ponechat. Also skip the marker verify loop for bookings that have a failed or completing queue entry. Make the identical change in both trees and add a test (queue result failed + marker present → no `fxSwapPaidNotice`).

issues.problem: The web shows the rounding only once the SQL is deployed (feature-detected). The app shows "Minimální platba kartou je 15 Kč – zaplatíš 15 Kč" / "Zaplatit 15 Kč" unconditionally. Until p1–p4 are live, the server refuses with rounding_unavailable, and the app says "Server se právě aktualizuje… zkus to za pár minut" for as long as the SQL is missing. DESIGN §12.3 requires the app release only after SQL + edge are live, but PLAN.md orders E (release Android 4.2.0) before F (SQL bundle approval). The web has a similar gap after a partial deploy: the note is gated on `bookings.card_rounding` (p1), while the swap needs p3 and gear needs p4.
issues.fix: Reorder PLAN.md: apply p1–p4 together with the edge before the 4.2.0 release, and state it explicitly in step E. Alternatively, gate `CardRoundingNote` and `card_min` in the app on a one-shot detection, the same as `MG.cardRoundingLive` on the web (`select card_rounding limit 0`), and keep the old below-minimum behaviour until then. Deploy p1–p4 together so the web note never promises 15 Kč for a swap or gear change without p3/p4.

issues.problem: Amounts in the rounding texts go through `MG.formatPrice`, which uses 0 decimals for CZK and converts to EUR/PLN when the visitor has switched the display currency (cookie `mg_web_currency`). Fractional dues therefore show inconsistent numbers. A swap surcharge of 7.50 shows "Doplatek 8 Kč – kartou zaplatíte 15 Kč… Dorovnání 8 Kč" (8+8≠15). A due of 14.60 shows "Dorovnání 0 Kč" / "+0 Kč". With EUR selected the text mixes the hard-coded "15 Kč" with "zaplatíte 0,60 €", while Stripe charges CZK. The app uses `kcExact` for exactly this reason.
issues.fix: Make `fp()` in card-rounding.js always format CZK exactly: whole crowns without decimals, otherwise 2 decimals with a comma ("7,50 Kč"). Use it for `amount`, `rounding` and `charge` in `cardNoteEdit` / `cardNoteLines` and `payAmount`, never the display-currency converter. Add node tests for 7.5, 14.6 and EUR display.

issues.problem: These are the texts shown before the SQL is deployed. They say "server se právě aktualizuje – zkuste to za chvíli / později", which is a false promise for an indefinite period with no way forward. `CS.below_minimum_web` also tells the customer to "dokonči v aplikaci MotoGo24, která drobnou částku dorovná", but before the SQL the app cannot round either (rounding_unavailable), and after the SQL the web rounds by itself. It also uses tykání while the web uses vykání.
issues.fix: Use a neutral wording with a real alternative, in 8 languages: "Částku pod 15 Kč teď kartou zaplatit nejde. Nic jsme nestrhli." For the booking add "Zvolte platbu převodem (QR)", since the step-2 method chooser already offers it. For the shop add "Přidejte do košíku další zboží". In refusals.ts drop the app hint from `below_minimum_web`.

issues.problem: The "Vybrat jinou motorku / Ponechat současnou motorku" choices appear only when `localStorage editRez_swap_pending_<id>` exists. A customer who returns from Stripe in another browser or with cleared storage, or who paid for a bike change through the core 'moto' tab (reason moto_unavailable), gets only "Rozumím". The web failure text is also generic ("rezervace se mezitím změnila") for every non-taken reason (swap day passed, licence, booking ended). The app shows a specific text for each reason.
issues.fix: Return `swap: true` (or `kind: 'swap'|'edit'`) in the failed response of `complete_extension`; `md.chg` contains `_swap`. In paid.js use `o.swap = r.swap || !!sw`. When the reason is taken and the change is a core moto change, offer "Vybrat jinou motorku" that opens the 'moto' tab. Optionally map `swap_date_out_of_range` / `license_insufficient` / closed-booking reasons to specific `editRez.paid.*` texts, as the app does with `pdFailDate` / `pdFailStatus`.

issues.problem: Waive case (due ≤ 1 Kč): the note says "nic nezaplatíte" / "změnu uložíme bez platby", but the amount chip on the booking step 2 and the e-shop pay amount still show "1 Kč", because `payAmount()` handles only 'round'. In the edit flows the redirect for a waived change then shows "Platba potvrzena, dokončuji změnu…" although nothing was paid.
issues.fix: In `refreshRez` / `refreshShop` pass `fp(0)` to `payAmount` when `MG.cardCharge(due).kind === 'waive'`. In paid.js, when no `session_id` is present and the pending entry has a negative `r` (waived), replace the applying text with `editRez.card.waive` before waiting.

issues.problem: The code map `_pk` lacks `already_paid`, `auth_required`, `forbidden`, `not_found` and `wrong_status`. rezervace.php already exports their translated `editRez.pay.*` texts, but they are unused. These codes therefore end in `alert("Chyba platby: <Czech server text>")` for all 8 languages. `already_paid` (second tab / double click) should count as success (D4 "success-like") but leaves the customer on step 2.
issues.fix: Add `auth_required:'authRequired', forbidden:'forbidden', not_found:'notFound', wrong_status:'wrongStatus'` to `_pk`. Handle `h.code==='already_paid'` like `h.success&&h.free`: clear the form state and redirect to `/potvrzeni?booking_id=<id>`.

issues.problem: The payment-failed page still says "Pokud to nepůjde ani na druhý pokus, ozvi se nám — domluvíme jiný způsob platby", a contact suggestion in a payment error state, which D5 forbids. It also mixes tykání with the vykání used elsewhere on the web.
issues.fix: In all 8 languages, replace it with a self-service next step, e.g. "Když to nepůjde ani na druhý pokus, zkuste jinou kartu nebo zvolte platbu převodem (QR) – nic jsme nestrhli."

issues.problem: The rounding line is pushed right after the booking line and before the bundled e-shop items and shipping. On the Stripe page the order reads "Rezervace · Dorovnání na minimální platbu kartou · Tričko · Doprava", so the rounding appears to apply only to the booking, although it was computed from booking + shop. The amounts themselves are correct.
issues.fix: Push the rounding line item after the bundled shop items and the shipping line, i.e. move the `if (rounding) lineItems.push(...)` block below the shopOrder block.

issues.problem: When a paid swap is refunded because the bike was taken, the customer gets no written confirmation. The direct Stripe refund sends no e-mail, and the old process-refund path with its credit-note e-mail was removed. The web 'finishing' path (no result after about 40 s) and the app (after a restart, see the app issue above) can leave the customer without ever seeing the on-screen message.
issues.fix: After mode 'auto' or 'staff', send the customer a short e-mail through send-email in the booking language: "Motorka je mezitím obsazená – nová rezervace má přednost, vaše rezervace platí beze změny, doplatek X vracíme na kartu (5–10 pracovních dnů)", without contact details. Send it once per payment, guarded by the existing `debug_log` lock row.
